task_instance: Build an end-to-end AutoML pipeline for a tabular binary-classification dataset (customer-churn style, 600 rows with numeric + categorical features and injected missing values): data-quality checks, feature preprocessing (imputation, one-hot encoding, standard scaling), automated model search and hyperparameter tuning across algorithm families, hold-out + CV evaluation, and an exportable deployable model artifact plus a report.
evidence: Set up a Python 3.13 venv inside the work dir (python -m venv .venv) and pip-installed (quiet) scikit-learn 1.9.1, pandas, numpy, pyyaml, joblib, and a genuine AutoML framework from the skill's prerequisite list: TPOT 1.1.0 (installing setuptools<81 to restore pkg_resources that its stopit dependency needs on Python 3.13). Created a realistic user-input dataset.csv (make_data.py; 600 rows, 4 features, 45 missing cells, classes 401/199) and config.yaml adapted from the skill's assets/pipeline_template.yaml. Wrote automl_pipeline.py following the skill's Instructions/implementation.md steps: it loads the CSV, prints a data-quality assessment (row count, feature typing, per-column missingness, class balance), builds a ColumnTransformer preprocessing stage (mean imputation + StandardScaler for numerics, most_frequent imputation + OneHotEncoder for the categorical 'city'), does a stratified 75/25 split, then runs TPOT's evolutionary AutoML search (search_space='linear', 3 generations, population 12, 3-fold CV, roc_auc objective, 2-min budget) for model selection + hyperparameter tuning across algorithm families. Ran it with `python -I automl_pipeline.py`: TPOT completed 3 generations (~49s) and selected a Normalizer -> SelectFromModel(ExtraTreesClassifier) -> classifier pipeline. Hold-out metrics: accuracy 0.7733, F1 0.8172, ROC-AUC 0.8374, precision 0.8837, recall 0.76. Exported artifacts/best_pipeline.pkl (254 KB, preprocessing + fitted best model via joblib) and artifacts/report.json. Verified the deliverable by reloading best_pipeline.pkl in a fresh process and predicting on 5 rows -> labels [1,1,0,0,1] with probabilities [0.856,0.58,0.454,0.481,0.72]. The skill's bundled files (SKILL.md, references/, assets/, scripts/pipeline_deployment.py) were all present; nothing needed from them was missing. All files are under the work directory: dataset.csv, config.yaml, automl_pipeline.py, make_data.py, artifacts/best_pipeline.pkl, artifacts/report.json.
